## Listen to the notes

Select **Read aloud**, then **Stop reading** to cancel.

::: {.notes}
These are the speaker notes. The button reads these notes, rather than the visible slide content.

A second paragraph should follow with a space between sentences.
:::

## No notes

The button is disabled when this slide has no notes.

## Another slide

Use the keyboard to focus the button and press Enter or Space.

::: {.notes}
Changing slides stops speech. Reading never starts automatically.
:::
